name: social-media-platform
description: A full-stack social media platform built with React, Express, MongoDB, and Socket.IO.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix back-end" "npm run dev --prefix front-end"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix back-end && npm install --prefix front-end
